args:
Implement OOTDay frontend UI theme and styling based on the 
  brand style guide. 

  ## Color Palette
  - Primary background: #F5F0EB (cream/beige)
  - Primary accent: #C41E3A (deep crimson/magenta) - for buttons, headers, product cards
  - Secondary text: #4A3728 (dark brown)
  - Card background: #FFFFFF (white)
  - Decorative accent: #B8860B (gold/bronze)

  ## Typography
  - Headers: Bold, sentence case with accent color (#C41E3A) for key words
  - Body text: Clean sans-serif, dark brown (#4A3728)
  - Button text: White on crimson background, bold

  ## UI Components to Style

  ### Buttons
  - Primary: Solid #C41E3A background, white text, rounded-lg corners
  - Secondary: Outlined with #C41E3A border
  - Circle navigation buttons: Solid #C41E3A with white arrow icons

  ### Cards
  - Product cards: #C41E3A background, white text, rounded-xl corners
  - Style selection cards: White/cream background with #C41E3A border on selection
  - Chat message cards: Rounded corners with subtle shadow

  ### Input Fields
  - Rounded-lg rectangle with #C41E3A border
  - Placeholder text in light gray

  ### Chat Interface
  - AI messages: Left-aligned with crimson avatar icon, white bubble
  - User messages: Right-aligned, cream/beige (#F5F0EB) bubble
  - Floating chat panel with rounded-xl corners on luxurious backdrop

  ### Selection States
  - Selected items: #C41E3A border/outline
  - Hover states: Lighter crimson tint

  ## Files to Update
  - Update Tailwind CSS config with custom colors (ootday-crimson, ootday-cream, ootday-brown, 
  ootday-gold)
  - Update global styles in styles/ directory
  - Update component themes in components/ui/ to use new color scheme
  - Ensure consistency across all existing components

  ## Brand Identity
  - App name: OOTDay
  - Tagline: Think outfit. Think OOTDay
  - Tone: Friendly, approachable (Your BFFs here)
  - Use emojis sparingly but effectively
